description: REAL forecast values: every hour of the Swell Travel Agent multi-model blend run blend:6e67a441174f999b (members NOAA GFS-Wave + GFS 2026-10-11 18Z, direct from NOAA open data, and ECMWF IFS HRES + ecWAM 2026-10-11 12Z open data, 0.25 deg) whose wind speed is 30 km/h or more (502 of 4050 hours, 50 spots). Extracted on 2026-10-14 from a copy of the swell_live2 database; values rounded to 4 decimals. v200 is each hour's score, label and wind relation under algorithm 2.0.0, rescored on the same copy after re-seeding the spot profiles from data/surf_spots.
